flags.title: Supplied short-link slugs are 9 characters; ASINs are 10
flags.detail: The five link.amazon slugs (for example B04G1MEwY) are 9 characters. The redirect targets are 10-character ASINs. The slug is therefore not itself an ASIN. The intended ASIN for each link is unconfirmed; the observed redirect ASIN is recorded separately. An official Amazon help-centre page defining ASIN was not located; the definition used comes from the Seller Central forum (SRC-11).

flags.title: Intended ASIN not confirmed for any of the five links
flags.detail: No intended ASIN was supplied with the brief. Intended ASIN, confirmation date and confirmation source are blank. Each observed redirect is recorded as observed only.

flags.title: Special Link validation not performed
flags.detail: The brief requires one link per product tested in the enrolled Associates workflow (destination and tracking report) before scaling. This session has no Associates login, so the test was not run. The supplied short links are kept as submitted. They are not claimed to be valid or invalid. Their status is unresolved (see the brief's reference to FLG-003).

flags.title: Tracking ID shopnow047c-20 not verified
flags.detail: The Tracking ID was supplied in the brief. This session cannot confirm that it belongs to an Associates account or that the supplied short links carry it. No tagged links were generated.

flags.title: Prices, ratings, and commission rates not published
flags.detail: Listing prices and ratings were not captured from the observed pages, and no official API access was confirmed. Commission rates were not verified. None are shown on the site.

flags.title: Five analytics events were not defined in the brief
flags.detail: The brief asks for 'the five defined events' but does not list them. The five events in this build (page_view, outbound_click, guide_scroll_75, table_filter, feed_subscribe_click) are a proposal for owner approval.

flags.title: Self-hosted analytics endpoint is not hosted
flags.detail: GitHub Pages serves static files only. The endpoint in endpoint/ is built and tested locally but is not deployed. The site's tracker is disabled until an endpoint URL is set. No analytics data exists yet.

flags.title: No named author; brand name is a working name
flags.detail: The brief asks for authorship. No author identity was supplied, and none is invented. The site uses 'Counter Notes' as a working name pending owner decision.

flags.title: Another session has claimed an overlapping build
flags.detail: Branch arena/cba9af3f-prod1 on origin claims 'Build the publication-style affiliate website' (scope: index.html, styles.css, site.js, guides/, review/, data/, feed.xml, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, README.md, COORDINATION.md). This branch builds in site source and docs/ to avoid file collisions, but the two builds overlap in purpose. The owner must choose which build publishes. Logged in COORDINATION.md.

flags.title: Zone4 references are not official sources
flags.detail: The brief's S-, D-, F- and Q- identifiers point to a third-party project (kanlerxz87-cyber/Zone4). Their statuses are reported as the brief states them and were not independently verified.

flags.title: Some register rows have no source supplied
flags.detail: Register rows S-07, S-20 and S-25 have no source link in the brief and no status. They are marked unverified on the register page.

flags.title: Product photography not used
flags.detail: No product photos are shown. Use of Amazon-supplied imagery depends on Program Content terms in the Operating Agreement (SRC-06); the brief's S-18 remains a decision for the owner.

flags.title: Repository was a blank starter
flags.detail: The repository contained only a README (7 bytes), with no license, tests, or Pages configuration. This branch adds a build and checks, a COORDINATION.md, and a README.
